name: FJCG-52
summary: A Flexmo compliant robot joint module in HAMOOBot’s Titan series. The module combines an elastic output structure with geared actuation and dual absolute-encoder feedback. Its stated rated torque is 20 N·m, peak torque 52 N·m and mass 1.5 kg.
